Nora (finance): FYI nightly ingest shows ~14% of eu-west GPU spend as UNLABELED after a spot-preempt wave. Estimated $3,120. Screenshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/costs/spot-preempt-1755001234
OpsBot: [ALERT] billing-watch: unlabeled_gpu_ratio=14.3% project=eu-shared-spot :warning:
Sam (finops): Can we map by instance_id / invoice_line to decide owners quickly?
Nora (finance): I ran a quick query and uploaded CSV: https://files.redwood.ai/fin/1755001234-orphaned-spot.csv
```sql
-- orphaned_spot_mappings_last_24h
SELECT instance_id, invoice_id, IFNULL((SELECT value FROM UNNEST(labels) l WHERE l.key='team'),'UNLABELED') as team, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.gcp_line_items
WHERE project_id = 'eu-shared-spot' AND DATE(usage_start_time)=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY instance_id, invoice_id, team
```
Luca (eng-infra): We had a preemptive drain loop during the kernel upgrade window; legacy pool agents don't reapply labels after reprovision. That’s likely the cause.
Priya (eng-ml): We launched a long-running hyperparam sweep that survived several preempts; some runs were reattached to new instances and lost labels. Agree to claim if it's ours.
Sam (finops): Estimate of confirmed match to eng-ml by job_id is $2,400. Remaining $720 unlabeled. Propose finance apply 1) retroassign confirmed $2,400 to eng-ml, 2) split $720 70/20/10 infra/eng-ml/svc oncall (infra asks for a migration credit).
Nora (finance): OK. Need written confirmation from eng-ml and eng-infra to proceed. Also attach job IDs in the ledger entry note: "retroassign 1755001234-orphaned-spot"
Priya (eng-ml): Confirmed. We'll provide job IDs and timestamp ranges. We'll add a CI gate to reapply labels post-recreate.
Luca (eng-infra): Confirmed. Infra accepts the proposed split and requests a one-time migration credit up to $200; finance may approve.
OpsBot: Task TSK-1122 created: "orphaned-spot-backfill + ledger" assigned to finance + eng-infra + eng-ml.
Sam (finops): Nora, please run the backfill and post ledger journal once you have files. Nora (finance): On it. I'll run backfill today and post entries with links to CSV and task. Also adding weekly check to FIN runbook for spot preempt windows.
